name: claude-sessions
description: Work that runs in a Claude session other than this one: consult another model, delegate bounded work this session collects, spawn an independent Stint, or stand up a monitor that wakes on an event, a clock, or its own rounds

interface.shortDescription: Consult, delegate, spawn a Stint, or stand up a monitor
interface.longDescription: Routes work into a Claude session other than the current one. Chooses the completion contract — a result this session collects, or independent work recorded at its own destination — and the wake mechanism for a monitor: an event source, a schedule, or a session driving its own rounds. From Codex the launch is fire-and-forget and is verified through the CLI.
